purpose: G3 phase 2: on the SAME ideal-condition truths as the G3 gate (bit-for-bit reproduced), compare four mixing/interaction strategies (full IMM, no-interaction likelihood, static mixing, oracle) on identification (posterior probability mass) and forecast RMSE at leads 1/3/7, to quantify how much the full interaction machinery adds over simpler strategies and how close it gets to a known-truth oracle.

gate_evidence_for_cross_check.meaning: reproduced parameter_only full-arm forecast, truth forecast and observations must be bit-identical to the sealed gate; proves the same truths are reused and the gate verdict is untouched

hypotheses.primary_identification_metric: median true-candidate posterior probability (probability mass); per the G3 gate criterion lesson, per-day argmax is not used for any verdict
hypotheses.H1_interaction_adds_identification: per stage, full median true-candidate probability >= none median true-candidate probability
hypotheses.H2_interaction_adds_forecast_skill: per lead, paired forecast RMSE satisfies full <= none <= static (paired matched-block bootstrap 95% CI on the difference excludes zero in the hypothesized direction)
hypotheses.H3_gap_to_oracle: per lead, report full RMSE / oracle RMSE, and full should be closer to oracle than static is
hypotheses.negative_results_reported: if full does not beat none/static, report that interaction adds no value at ideal conditions; verdicts are frozen and not adjusted post hoc

scope_limit: Phase-2 value comparison on one favorable condition (spacing multiplier 8, stage length 180, observation noise 2.6% of mean discharge), the same truths as the G3 ideal gate reused bit-for-bit. Establishes only how much the full interaction machinery adds over no-interaction, static mixing, and an oracle at ideal conditions; does not establish behavior at other spacings, budgets, noise levels, scenarios, or real basins.
